changes: Read support tickets independently from customer/order lookup, assignee, workload and summary failures.
Skip customer and order lookups when the current role cannot use them; separate support view, create/message and edit controls.
Create support tickets and messages with actor-scoped recovery keys, one atomic audit and no repeated status side effects on replay.
Bind uncertain client retries to the original endpoint as well as the original body and key.
Keep drafts with their own ticket, ignore stale or canceled detail responses and retain confirmed write success separately from refresh errors.
Validate internal-note booleans, active assignees and trimmed text; use the Istanbul year for ticket numbers.
Render internal notes and public messages in distinct boxes, translate staff/action labels and export displayed filters through XLSX with Istanbul dates.
